name: Kor
description: The Kor are a people of Zendikar, skilled with ropes and kitesails, who are Nahiri's people and whom she taught lithomancy.

description_citations.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Kor twins roped Nissa's party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders, and Ob Nixilis saw Nahiri's face in each of the kor.

citations.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.
"Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

bio.text: Nahiri recalled living among the kor for centuries, teaching them lithomancy and training them to guard the prison before withdrawing to the Eye of Ugin.
During the Eldrazi war a kor was carried off and consumed, only a few dozen survived under Commander Vorik, and Gideon and the kor led the wounded up ropes onto the hedrons.
A hundred kor on kitesails arrived from Tazeem to join Drana's fight, but the kor were slaughtered by the Eldrazi.
Later, kor sentries found Nahiri and Tenri healed her wounds, and Nahiri is called an ancient kor.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Volrath draws the Kor into Rath along with other peoples.
timeline.quote: The Kor were drawn into Rath by Volrath like other peoples

citation.text: "Kor", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reclusive Kor unite because of the need to destroy Volrath.
timeline.quote: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

citation.text: Warrior en-Kor (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rath's new evincar eliminates the moggs and takes the Kor as a new slave race.
timeline.quote: Rath's new evincar eliminated the brutish moggs and took a new slave race

citation.text: Kor Dirge (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kor travel nomadically across Zendikar hunting mikunga on the Roil-churned winds, connecting to their surroundings with lines and hooks.
timeline.quote: The kor follow a nomadic lifestyle, chasing the winds across Zendikar, hunting the mikunga

citation.text: "The Master at Arms". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

citation.text: "Akoum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Eldrazi's return, kor gather around Glasspool and carve dwellings in the surrounding peaks.
timeline.quote: During the eldrazi's return, kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kor empire collapses after a civil war between the city and its Skyclave; the Skyclave falls onto Jwar Isle, fracturing the land into the Trenches.
timeline.quote: The Skyclave fell onto Jwar Isle , fracturing the land into the Trenches seen today.

citation.text: "Makindi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that the Kor's appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that their appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.

citation.text: "Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator's intended lair site becomes an elemental and goes off to terrorize some kor.

timeline.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
timeline.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Kargans, riding tamed dragons, shatter the Akoum Skyclave, ending Kor rule in the region.
timeline.quote: Their coordinated attacks ultimately succeeded in bringing down the Skyclave.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kor herders of the Pillar Plains are massacred in 4537 and their bodies hung over Thunder Gap.

timeline.summary: During the civil war the Ondu Skyclave turns against Makindi, destroying it, and falls onto Jwar Isle.

timeline.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
